outline.unique_angle: Every top-3 competitor stops at 'use AI to generate plans + here are the risks.' None show the SELECTION step — comparing several AI outputs and rejecting four because they aren't anchored in the service's specific physical environment. The concrete angle: a place-based filter (touchable / revisitable / child-led) that demotes the AI idea that reads best in favour of the garden bed children can dig in every day. This is lived ECE practice the SaaS blogs structurally can't replicate.
